title: DCVD: Dual-Channel Cross-Modal Fusion for Joint Vulnerability Detection and Localization
abstract: arXiv:2605.11015v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Software vulnerability detection plays a critical role in ensuring system security, where real-world auditing requires not only determining whether a function is vulnerable but also pinpointing the specific lines responsible. However, existing approaches either rely on a single information source -- sequential, structural, or semantic -- failing to jointly exploit the complementary strengths across modalities, or treat statement-level localization merely as a byproduct of function-level detection without explicit line-level supervision. To address these limitations, we propose DCVD (Dual-Channel Cross-Modal Vulnerability Detection), a unified framework that performs joint function-level detection and statement-level localization. translated_title: DCVD：用于联合漏洞检测与定位的双通道跨模态融合方法
translated_abstract: 软件漏洞检测在保障系统安全方面发挥着关键作用，而现实世界的安全审计不仅需要判断某个函数是否存在漏洞，还需要精确定位导致漏洞的具体代码行。然而，现有方法要么仅依赖单一信息源——序列、结构或语义信息——无法联合利用不同模态之间的互补优势；要么将语句级定位仅仅视为函数级检测的副产品，缺乏显式的行级监督。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了DCVD（双通道跨模态漏洞检测），这是一个能够同时执行函数级检测和语句级定位的统一框架。DCVD通过两个并行分支提取控制依赖特征和语义特征，并通过对比对齐结合双向交叉注意力机制对其进行融合，有效弥合了……
tldr: DCVD提出了一种双通道跨模态融合的统一框架，通过对比对齐和双向交叉注意力联合利用控制依赖与语义信息，同时实现函数级漏洞检测与语句级漏洞精确定位。
en_tdlr: DCVD is a unified dual-channel cross-modal fusion framework that jointly performs function-level vulnerability detection and statement-level localization by integrating control-dependency and semantic features via contrastive alignment and bidirectional cross-attention.
